reviewNotes: USA cohort membership requires a first-party U.S. headquarters/office source and a dated 2026 engineering hiring source. Current postings show hiring intent and do not prove completed hires.
Caliza's U.S. location is supported by its 2026 SEC Form D principal-place-of-business address in Miami, Florida. The SEC record is registry evidence, not LATAM hiring evidence.
TRM Labs' 2026 federal award and company news are separate discovery/supporting sources; neither proves LATAM hiring. The current first-party LATAM software posting is the hiring evidence.
Six selected names already exist in the broad Comp catalog. Their domain/name matches in the saved Mongo snapshot are intentional upserts to add USA cohort evidence and tags, not new company records.

66degrees and Goodway Group were excluded from this batch: current company ATS pages did not provide a live LATAM software posting at review time. Siena AI was excluded from the USA cohort because its currently verified U.S. headquarters/office evidence was insufficient under the profile criteria.
